title: Muon Sublates the Edge of Stability in LLM Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2609.34915v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Muon is increasingly used for language-model pretraining, yet its large-step dynamics are not captured by the classical edge-of-stability (EoS) picture of gradient descent (GD). In GD, loss neutrality, equal-magnitude update reversal, and marginal stability meet at a single learning-rate-dependent edge. We show that Muon breaks this coupling. For stochastic no-momentum Muon, we derive a coherence-corrected conditional loss-neutral boundary $2\rho_b/\eta$, while temporal alignment follows a separate geometry. Controlled experiments show that loss balance and temporal alignment respond differently to learning rate and batch size. Across our language model experiments, the 130M Llama-like LLM runs exhibit loss-boundary tracking with weak negative alignment, whereas the studied 1B LLM configuration shows stronger partial cancellation; in both settings, directions remain far from coherent reversal while training continues to improve. Thes

translated_title: Muon 扬弃了大语言模型预训练中的稳定性边缘
translated_abstract: Muon 优化器正被越来越多地用于语言模型预训练，但其大步长动态无法被梯度下降（GD）经典的“稳定性边缘”（EoS）理论图景所刻画。在 GD 中，损失中性、等幅更新反转与边缘稳定性汇聚于一个由学习率决定的单一边缘。我们证明 Muon 打破了这种耦合。对于随机无动量的 Muon，我们推导出一个经相干性校正的条件损失中性边界 $2\rho_b/\eta$，而时间对齐则遵循另一套独立的几何规律。受控实验表明，损失平衡与时间对齐对学习率和批大小的响应方式各不相同。在我们的语言模型实验中，130M 规模的类 Llama 模型运行表现出损失边界跟踪并伴随弱负对齐，而所研究的 1B 模型配置则展现出更强的部分抵消效应；在两种设置下，更新方向都远离相干反转，同时训练持续改善。
tldr: Muon 优化器打破了大语言模型预训练中梯度下降的稳定性边缘耦合框架，其损失中性边界与时间对齐遵循不同几何规律，且更新方向始终远离相干反转、训练持续改善。
en_tdlr: Muon sublates the classical edge-of-stability picture in LLM pretraining by decoupling loss neutrality from temporal alignment, with update directions remaining far from coherent reversal while training continues to improve.
